newsitem.title: UK: UK's Blair-spending proposals properly costed.
newsitem.headline: UK's Blair-spending proposals properly costed.

text.p: Britain's Labour Party leader Tony Blair said on Thursday all of his government's spending proposals if it wins the May 1 election will be properly costed.
"Every single proposal that we have for spending is properly costed," he told BBC radio ahead of the publication of his party's manifesto later on Thursday.
Blair said he wanted a tax system that encouraged work and his government's priority in the tax system would be to reduce the starting rate of tax to help low income families.

In his contract with the British people which forms the centrepiece of his party 10-point manifesto, Blair pledged that education would be his number one priority and that he would not raise income taxes for the next five years.
